title: Projected gradient methods for nonconvex and stochastic smooth optimization: new complexities and auto-conditioned stepsizes
abstract: arXiv:2412.14291v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We present a novel class of projected gradient (PG) methods for minimizing a smooth but not necessarily convex function over a convex compact set. We first provide a novel analysis of the constant-stepsize PG method, achieving a unified iteration complexity for finding an approximate stationary point for convex and nonconvex problems. We then develop an "auto-conditioned" projected gradient (AC-PG) variant that achieves the same iteration complexity without requiring the input of the Lipschitz constant of the gradient or any line search procedure. The key idea is to estimate the Lipschitz constant using first-order information gathered from the previous iterations, and to show that the error caused by underestimating the Lipschitz constant can be properly controlled. translated_title: 用于非凸和随机光滑优化的投影梯度方法：新的复杂度界与自适应条件步长
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一类新颖的投影梯度（PG）方法，用于在凸紧集上最小化光滑但不一定凸的函数。我们首先对常数步长PG方法提供了新颖的分析，为凸和非凸问题寻找近似驻点实现了统一的迭代复杂度。随后，我们开发了一种“自适应条件”投影梯度（AC-PG）变体，它在无需输入梯度Lipschitz常数或任何线搜索程序的情况下即可达到相同的迭代复杂度。其关键思想是利用从先前迭代中收集的一阶信息来估计Lipschitz常数，并证明低估Lipschitz常数所引起的误差可以得到适当控制。接着，我们将PG方法推广到随机设置，提出了随机投影梯度（SPG）方法和方差缩减随机梯度方法（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了一类自适应条件的投影梯度方法，无需预知梯度Lipschitz常数或线搜索即可在凸与非凸优化问题上实现统一的迭代复杂度，并进一步推广至随机优化设置。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel class of auto-conditioned projected gradient methods that achieve unified iteration complexity for convex and nonconvex smooth optimization without requiring the Lipschitz constant or line search, with extensions to the stochastic setting.
